# NotificationPolicy

`cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1` · Namespaced · [all resources](../README.md)

| Operation | Request |
|---|---|
| observe | `GET /accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies/{policy_id}` |
| create | `POST /accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies` |
| update | `PUT /accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies/{policy_id}` |
| delete | `DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies/{policy_id}` |

References: `accountRef` → Account / ClusterAccount.

Credentials: via account.

## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1
kind: NotificationPolicy
metadata:
  name: example
spec:
  forProvider:
    accountRef:
      name: <name>
    alert_type: "abuse_report_alert"
    enabled: false
    mechanisms:
    name: <name>
```
